title: MixinTweaks
description: A simple mod that adds a few QoL improvements using mixins.
body:
This mod is a simple QoL mod that gives you the option to disable certain annoyances in minecraft. All of the features can be toggled on or off. This mod is also very lightweight.

# Currently Implemented Features
- Hide reverse third person when you cycle through F5
- Hide held item tooltips when you switch items in your hotbar

# Dependencies
- YetAnotherConfigLib
- Fabric API
- Mod Menu
